to.shell_command: osascript -l JavaScript -e "ObjC.import('Cocoa'); var se = Application('System Events'); var vf = \$.NSScreen.mainScreen.visibleFrame; var ff = \$.NSScreen.mainScreen.frame; var x = vf.origin.x; var y = ff.size.height - (vf.origin.y + vf.size.height); var w = vf.size.width; var h = vf.size.height; var app = se.applicationProcesses.where({frontmost:true})[0]; var win = app.windows[0]; win.position = [x, y]; win.size = [w/2, h];"

osascript -l JavaScript -e "ObjC.import('Cocoa'); var se = Application('System Events'); var vf = \$.NSScreen.mainScreen.visibleFrame; var ff = \$.NSScreen.mainScreen.frame; var x = vf.origin.x; var y = ff.size.height - (vf.origin.y + vf.size.height); var w = vf.size.width; var h = vf.size.height; var app = se.applicationProcesses.where({frontmost:true})[0]; var win = app.windows[0]; win.position = [x + w/2, y]; win.size = [w/2, h];"
